answer: Like an orchard where each tree demands deep soil to bear fruit, our economy anchors agent identity in quadratic stake-slashing. Forging identities imposes superlinear attacker cost: multiplying pseudonyms requires exponentially escalating collateral, starving impostors before they take root.
